title: Data Protection Administrator
description:
Here's a professional job advert based on your notes:

Data Protection Administrator (SARs)

Remote Full-Time Temporary (2-4 Weeks)

We are currently seeking an experienced Data Protection Administrator to support our clients team on a temporary basis for an initial 2-4 week assignment. This role will focus on managing a backlog of Subject Access Requests (SARs) and ensuring requests are processed accurately and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing and managing Subject Access Requests (SARs) in line with GDPR and data protection requirements.
- Working through an existing backlog of SAR requests.
- Managing a shared inbox and responding to SAR-related enquiries.
- Maintaining and updating request tracking logs and reporting tools.
- Liaising with internal stakeholders and IT teams to gather required information.
- Reviewing requests and advising on the information required to progress cases.
- Supporting the end-to-end SAR process to ensure requests are completed within required timescales.

Essential Requirements
- Previous experience processing Subject Access Requests (SARs).
- Strong understanding of GDPR and data protection principles.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Ability to manage multiple requests and prioritise workload effectively.
- Experience maintaining trackers and administrative records.
- Confident communicating with stakeholders across different business areas.
- Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.

Contract Details
- Duration: 2-4 weeks
- Hours: Full-time
- Location: Fully remote
- Start Date: Immediate start available

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Data Protection professional looking for a short-term assignment with an immediate impact.

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age

title: Dispatch Administrator
description:
Dispatch Administrator

Location: Forfar
Contract Type: Temporary Assignment with Potential Extension or Permanent
Hours: 37.5 Hours per Week
Shift Pattern: Monday to Friday, Day Shift (Flexible Start and Finish Times)
Pay Rate: 15.27 per Hour
Start Date: Immediate Start Available (Subject to Successful Interview)

Experienced Dispatch Administrator Required

Are you an experienced Dispatch Administrator looking for your next opportunity?

We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a Dispatch Administrator to join a busy manufacturing and distribution operation in Forfar. This role requires someone who can confidently step into a fast-paced environment and take ownership of dispatch administration activities from day one.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and detail-focused individual who enjoys working in a fast-moving operational environment, ensuring products are dispatched accurately, efficiently and on schedule.

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate the dispatch and transportation of goods to customers.
- Ensure customer orders are processed accurately and delivered within agreed timescales.
- Maintain accurate dispatch records, documentation and system updates.
- Produce dispatch reports and analyse operational data.
- Process and verify transport invoices and associated paperwork.
- Liaise with transport providers, customers and internal departments to ensure smooth delivery operations.
- Support operational reporting and administrative activities.
- Provide general administration support to the wider operations team as required.

Essential Requirements

To be successful in this role, you must have:
- Previous Dispatch Administration, Dispatch Coordinator or Dispatch Planning experience.
- Experience working within a logistics, transport, warehouse, manufacturing or distribution environment.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Excel and Outlook.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- A proactive approach and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive pay rate of 15.27 per hour.
- Weekly pay.
- 37.5 paid hours per week.
- Monday to Friday day shift pattern with flexibility around start and finish times.
- Friendly and supportive team environment.
- Immediate start available.
- Potential for the assignment to be extended or become permanent for the right candidate.

Apply Today

If you have proven Dispatch Administration experience and are available to start at short notice, we'd love to hear from you.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a well-established business where your dispatch knowledge and organisational skills will make an immediate impact.

Apply now to be considered for an immediate interview.
